alternatives.option: support prompt-type hooks on SessionStart at all and crashes on resume

context: Phase 5 complete: Fixed SessionStart prompt-type hook crash on session resume (issue #8). Replaced broken prompt hook with command hook that emits additionalContext JSON.
rationale: this is documented in the spec and verified in issue #8 investigation. The command-type with additionalContext is the only supported form for both startup and resume events.
summary: Chose command-type hook with additionalContext JSON output over prompt-type hook because Claude Code does NOT support prompt-type hooks on SessionStart at all and crashes on resume
